svg.title: Crystal Genealogy Exploded
svg.desc: Five descendants recur through five generations. Spread 2.8 exceeds the slider maximum 1.2; a phase increment of 11.73 radians exceeds its maximum 2. The motifs disperse into a cropped mineral genealogy with thousands of translucent facets. Native toolbar flow: nested polygon echoes → sheared facet layers.
